$schema_comment: v2-#22 — single source-of-truth for the customer-visible archetype roster. Add a new archetype here FIRST; the cross-SDK parity test then enforces that every supported language (api-types, Go SDK, TypeScript SDK, Python SDK, server runtime) references the same canonical id + display label. Drift on any SDK (e.g. iPhone 17 in TS while Python still has iPhone 16 Pro) fails the test at CI time.
